'''Oliver Grayson''' is an [[ally]]. He was made available as a mail-in promotional for purchasing ''Ghouls of the Miskatonic''.

==Card info==
*+1 [[Luck]]
*+1 [[Speed]]

When you fail an '''[[Evade check]]''', [[monster]]s do not deal [[combat damage]] to you.

==Mythos Source==

Oliver Grayson first appeared in ''Ghouls of the Miskatonic'', written by Graham McNeill (2011).
